title: UGGs are Being Spotted at Ross and Shoppers are Searching High and Low to Track Them Down - NewsBreak
text: A few years ago, the whole internet was buzzing about UGG slippers. What followed were months of the cozy essentials being backordered, and when they were restocked they would sell out again almost instantly. That’s why, even though the chilly weather is months away, it’s best to stock up now. That way, you’re set with what’s bound to become an everyday fall and winter staple before they're hard to come by. Typically, go-to's like UGGs have a reputation for being on the pricier side. But that's where Ross comes in with another lifesaver for our budgets. 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade's Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 Lately, shoppers have been coming across the cutest UGG slippers for a bargain in stores. And people have been racing to Ross to try and find a pair. “OKAAAAY ROSS!!” one shopper excitedly gushed about its UGGs selection. Just look at all the gorgeous colors these come in. OKAAAY ROSS!!🙌🔥follow for more Ross finds content!💯💯 @Ross Dress for Less @UGG® #fyp #ross #rossfinds #deals #uggs #boots #shopping Instantly obsessed. As TikToker Deborah shows, Ross has the most stunning selection of light blue, navy blue, light purple, black and tan UGGs. Shoppers have also been finding discounted UGG Neumel boots at the store. In other words, some Ross stores are majorly packed with UGGs and shoppers are so here for it. The price of these UGGs range anywhere from as low as $39.99 to as high as $59.99. Regardless, a complete steal for one of the most iconic brands around. In another TikTok , one Ross shopper was shocked to find the light blue pair. “Went to return a pair and came out with 2 new pairs of shoes…” she wrote calling it "your sign to GO TO ROSS!". “The ugg shoes are you kidding me?!!” one user commented. “For $39 I would’ve immediately checked out.” Related: Ross' Dreamy Home Essential Looks Nearly Identical to a Popular Pottery Barn Style More Than 6x the Price “Is this real omggg,” someone asked in disbelief. “40$ UGGS ” another ecstatic user said. “The Uggs are a must,” someone raved. “No way running there now,” one determined user wrote. “I would cry,” someone simply said. All to say, these might be shoppers' favorite Ross finds yet. Since people are so obsessed though, you won’t want to wait around to see if your nearest Ross has these in stock. So do yourself a favor and head to Ross. You might just snag a go-to pair of low-cost slippers for the cold months that makes winter way more stylish and cozy.
